# Enclosure Lab — Univera LLC

> Source and design files for an FDM enclosure prototype intended for the logic board from Mac mini (M1, 2020). The released design is a digital prototype for unpowered fit checks; digital checks do not establish physical fit, electrical operation, cooling or wireless performance.

## Read first

- [Project overview and first print](README.md)
- [Revision selector](project.json): JSON with the active CAD, viewer, first-fit archive and published manifest paths. Resolve these paths from the repository root.
- [Frozen release receipt](release/d2.6-manifest.json): SHA-256 hashes for the published D2.6 files.
- [Project license](LICENSE): conditions for noncommercial use of independently authored material.
- [Third-party sources and rights](THIRD_PARTY.md): separate conditions for the board and other references.

## Working with this repository

- [First-fit guide](docs/guides/first-fit.md): English instructions for checking printer scale, fitting D2.6 without power and reporting observations. The [original Ukrainian instructions](cad/solidcraft-m1/prototype-d26/FIT-FIRST.md) are included unchanged in the kits.
- [CAD build](docs/CAD-BUILD.md): required external reference, pinned tools and build commands.
- [Viewer](docs/VIEWER.md): local preview, downloads and browser checks.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): reporting results and distinguishing source geometry, assumptions and physical measurements.
